Tasty vegetarian food immersion in Vietnamese style.
Mar 2025 • Couples
We had trouble making reservations. The telephone number listed on the Facebook and webpages is discontinued. Reply to FB post was too slow.
This restaurant was in a package with the Lune A&O show. Take a taxi or Grab to get there. 
We were seated inside. The restaurant was nearly void of patrons.
While the menu is extensive, the show package offers just two menu choices. We went with the Traditional Menu.
The setting and décor have a French mid 20th century feel.
Service was friendly but inattentive.
The food - all brought out at once - looked and tasted good.
We did not particularly selected this restaurant for its vegetarian menu but found the food tasty and varied.

Lovely surprise
Dec 2023 • Couples
We found the Bông Súng by accident, it was included in a very competitive deal for combo tickets with the AO show at the Saigon Opera House. 

We booked through Facebook Messenger - appreciating the near instant reply. We went to eat on a different day from the show and were offered a choice of two set menus. We went for the “fresh” rather than the “traditional” and it was excellent vegetarian fare, and plenty of it too. We also had soft drinks (peaches, smoothies) included. 

We would definitely eat here again. We saw the show the next evening and that was great too.
